hamburg-wuemme-teufelsmoor-loop.title: Hamburg · Wümme, Teufelsmoor and Artists’ Villages
hamburg-wuemme-teufelsmoor-loop.slogan: A 194 km loop out of Hamburg west edge
hamburg-wuemme-teufelsmoor-loop.story: Soft northern light, moor roads and café timing west of the city. A 194 km loop that starts and ends near Ottensen, about 3 h 58 of riding. The stops in between: Buxtehude exit, Zeven country roads, Worpswede artists’ village and Ottersberg Wümme roads.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Mesa Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3300 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Mesa Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 40 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

grand-mesa-scenic-byway.story: A 73 km one-way ride from near Cedaredge, about 1 h 12 of riding. The stops in between: Grand Mesa and Mesa Lakes. The highest point is about 3,300 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
